[EN] Tuwangis this way, tuwangis that way...I used to think they were kind of neat. You know. Before they started poisoning us and throwing rocks.
[ES] Tuwangis por aquí, tuwangis por allá... Antes pensaba que eran simpáticos. Ya sabes. Antes de que empezaran a envenenarnos y tirarnos rocas.
